title: tc-combobox
description: Pick one or many options from a searchable, grouped list; picked options show as chips.

value.description: The picked values. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

open.description: Whether the list is open. Changed by the user unless a tc-open-change listener calls preventDefault()

creatable.description: Offer "Create “…”" when nothing matches the typed text exactly

maxVisibleTags.description: Show at most this many chips, the rest as "+3" (Clean always stays one line)

label.description: Visible label above the field (or use a page <label for>)

name.description: Submitted with the form: one entry per picked value

disabled.description: Can't be changed or focused; also disabled inside a disabled <fieldset>

required.description: At least one value must be picked before the form submits

invalid.description: Shows the field as invalid (red edge, aria-invalid on the input)

hint.description: Lighter text after the label, e.g. a role or an email

avatar.description: An image URL, or true for initials from the label

color.description: A small color dot – nice for labels and tags

group.description: Options with the same group are listed under one title

keywords.description: Extra words that should find this option
